mentions.name: MalariaGEN mosquito kinship estimation tool
mentions.description: A tool for estimating kinship coefficients between mosquito genomes, developed as a Google Summer of Code project with MalariaGEN as part of genomic analysis for disease vector control. A smaller portion is being tied up for the GSoC submission, with continued work planned toward a research paper; the tool leans on AVX-512 and the Sleef library for high-performance numerical computation.
mentions.source_excerpt: Finishing up my GSoC project with MalariaGEN. We're writing a new tool to estimate kinship coefficients between mosquitoes genomes and the project got a lot bigger than I initially planned haha.
